name: copy-button
title: CopyButton
description: Accessible Solid button for copying text with copied/error visual state and UI-owned clipboard helper behavior.

meta.customization: Use ui-copy-button classes and data-slot/data-copied/data-error hooks to style icon-only or labelled copy controls.
meta.api: CopyButton accepts value, label, copiedLabel, errorLabel, copiedDuration, showLabel, onCopy, onCopyError, and normal button attributes. User onClick runs before copying and event.preventDefault cancels internal copy behavior.
meta.accessibility: Renders a native button with dynamic aria-label/title text, visible or screen-reader-only status label, and data state hooks for copied/error/unsupported feedback.
meta.limitations: CopyButton copies plain text only and does not render a tooltip or toast by itself. Compose those surfaces in app/docs code when persistent feedback is needed.

parity.visualReference: Matches shadcn-style source-owned copy button behavior in Solid form: icon button default, optional visible label, copied/error state, and data attributes for styling.
parity.baseUi: No Core/Base UI primitive is needed because the native button and generated clipboard hook cover the intrinsic semantics and browser boundary.
parity.kobalte: Comparable to a Kobalte button composition while remaining UI-owned source. Keystone keeps clipboard state out of Core and exposes cancellable user-first click handling.
